meaning_en: To bend down; to stoop low; to stand close to the ground with legs bent, like an animal when waiting for prey, or someone in fear.
example: We crouched behind the low wall until the squad of soldiers had passed by.

meaning_en: To retire a modeling kit or group of modeling kits.
example: I can't believe they squatted my favorite faction!

meaning_en: To rest in a horizontal position on a surface.
example: The book lies on the table; the snow lies on the roof; he lies in his coffin.

meaning_en: To cease from action, motion, work, or performance of any kind; stop; desist; be without motion.
example: My day's work is over; now I will rest.

meaning_en: To relieve from constipation; to loosen; to open.
example: An aperient relaxes the bowels.

meaning_en: To exert for the sake of training or improvement; to practice in order to develop.
example: to exercise troops or horses;  to exercise one's brain with a puzzle

meaning_en: Alternative spelling of practise.
example: They practice every day.

meaning_en: To do (something); to execute.
example: The scientists performed several experiments.

meaning_en: To adopt (an idea) as one's own.
example: to borrow the style, manner, or opinions of another

meaning_en: To allow to be used by someone temporarily, on condition that it or its equivalent will be returned.
example: I will only lend you my car if you fill up the tank.

meaning_en: To take a lease of premises in exchange for rent.
example: I rented a house from my friend's parents for a year.

meaning_en: To move or manipulate (something) using physical effort, usually with some difficulty or opposition.
example: I couldn't wrestle the trunk down the hall.

meaning_en: To engage in combat with; to oppose physically, to contest with.
example: My grandfather fought the Nazis in World War II.

meaning_en: To administer a blow to, directly or with a weapon or missile.
example: One boy hit the other.

meaning_en: To strike with one's fist.
example: If she punches me, I'm gonna break her nose.
